files.description: Streaming subscribers, one per row (320 rows): subscriber_id (whole number), age (years, from 19 to 87; about 1% empty), tier (basic, plus or premium; capital letters and spaces are inconsistent), monthly_fee (two decimals; about 3% empty), joined_year (whole number).

task_text: Group the subscribers by monthly fee band: 'under 5', '5-10' (5 to below 10), '10-20', '20-30' and '30+'. Report how many subscribers fall into each band; bands without subscribers must be listed with 0. Subscribers without a fee are left out. `result` should be a Series indexed by band label, in the band order above.
intended_computation: Count the 309 subscribers with a fee in the bands [0,5), [5,10), [10,20), [20,30), [30,inf); 'under 5' and '30+' are empty and must show 0.

predicted_direction.reason: on 3.x grouping by the binned categories drops the empty bands that the task asks to list

notes: Drafted 2026-11-11 in package TASKS_M1; task text, card, naive solution, reference and predicted direction were prepared there.
